name: Goblin Card RPG: Tower Trials
summary: Goblin Card RPG: Tower Trials is a roguelike deckbuilder set in a dark-fantasy world. The player controls Nibs, a goblin scavenger climbing a 100-floor dwarven tower. Each run starts with a new deck built from five archetypes: Miner, Tinker, Brewer, Runes and Wall. Turn-based card battles take place across a branching map with regular fights, elite enemies, shops, dice rooms and a boss on every floor. Relics, potions and permanent upgrades shape each run, and death ends the run. The game has six difficulty tiers, more than 140 enemies and 20 story chapters. An Endless Tower mode, added in update 1.0.5, continues past floor 100 with enemies that keep getting stronger. The game is free to play!
